post.description: Send a user message to a Room and schedule addressed Employees.

parameters.name: roomId
parameters.description: Room identifier; surrounding whitespace is ignored.

schema.description: Room identifier; surrounding whitespace is ignored.

targetIds.description: Employee identifiers addressed by the message; surrounding whitespace is ignored, and empty or duplicate values are removed.

attachments.description: Structured message attachments; null is treated as an empty list.

selectedFile.description: Selected local file reference; null or an empty path means no selected file.

userMessageId.description: Caller-provided idempotent user message identifier; surrounding whitespace is ignored.

assistantMessageIds.description: Reserved assistant message identifiers; surrounding whitespace is ignored, and empty or duplicate values are removed.

inReplyToMessageId.description: Parent message identifier for a reply; surrounding whitespace is ignored.

400.description: The request does not satisfy the operation contract.

401.description: A valid Bridge session or token is required.

403.description: The request origin is not allowed.

404.description: The reply parent message does not exist.
